project: VGA Civil War Strategy v2.11, midterm reconstruction (rajvardhan19)

agent_team.assistant: Claude Code (VS Code extension), model claude-opus-5-5
agent_team.purpose: Port mechanics from CWSTRAT.BAS, build the interface, players, runner, tests and harness under the student's direction.
agent_team.tools_and_permissions: Repository read/write and local commands in the student's workspace; no credentials, no push or PR without the student; no paid model calls.
agent_team.outputs: Code, tests, recorded QB64 comparisons and change summaries in the port-mechanic skill's format.
agent_team.handoff: Summary to the rules-reviewer; the student opens the PR.
agent_team.human_approval: The student accepts or rejects each change and submits.

agent_team.purpose: One procedure per mechanic: read one SUB, hand-trace with scripted dice, test first, port with QB64 numeric rules, compare with the original under QB64, record ambiguities, summarise.
agent_team.tools_and_permissions: Runs inside the implementation agent with its permissions.
agent_team.outputs: Map row, test, port, QB64 comparison result, QUESTIONS.md entry, summary.
agent_team.handoff: The summary is the reviewer's input.
agent_team.human_approval: The student accepts or rejects the summary's assumptions.

agent_team.purpose: Check fidelity against cited source lines, evidence labels, agreement of engine, tests, map and QB64 recordings, the information boundary, limits and evaluation fairness.
agent_team.tools_and_permissions: Read, Grep, Glob only; a fresh context that did not write the code; no instruction to approve.
agent_team.outputs: review.md: findings as [blocking | should fix | note] file:line lines.
agent_team.handoff: Findings to the student, who decides; accepted fixes go back to the implementation agent.

playing_agent.provider: vertex (Gemini on Vertex AI, course credit)
playing_agent.model: COURSE_MODEL at run time; the course suggests gemini-3.5-flash-lite. Results record the model_version the API returns.
playing_agent.sees: observe() and legal_actions() rendered as text, plus in history mode its own last 3 turns (actions, notes, turn reports)
never_sees: enemy leader, experience, supply or orders
playing_agent.memory_policy: history: last 3 turns of its own actions, notes and the visible turn report; obs-only: none beyond the current observation and the last rejection
playing_agent.output: JSON {actions: up to 8 legal action strings, note}; validated; submitted one at a time through step()
playing_agent.fallback: After 3 failed calls or fully rejected replies in a turn, or 40 actions in a turn, the runner submits 'end turn' labelled fallback with its reason. A model-call limit or wall-clock timeout ends the episode with that terminal reason.

baselines: original-ai (the original smarts/evaluate code playing the Union on the Union's observation)
opponent: The original computer player (SUB smarts), playing the Rebels with the full game state, as in the original.
logging_policy: Traces record observations' summaries, model proposals, notes, tokens, latency and every submitted action with its source. No credentials or personal data.
